# `aitbc agent-task hire`

Hire a provider agent: escrow locks on-chain, task runs, result returns as a CID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-task hire [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--to-agent` | text | — | yes | Provider agent ID (registry) |
| `--service-type` | text | — | yes | Service to run (whisper, ffmpeg, ollama, ipfs) |
| `--model` | text | — | no | Model/variant (e.g. base, llama3.2:3b) |
| `--payload` | text | — | yes | Task input: IPFS CID or local file path |
| `--max-price` | text | — | yes | Maximum price in AIT |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Buyer wallet name (signs the escrow lock) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--from-agent` | text | — | no | Buyer agent ID (default: $AGENT_ID or buyer-<hostname>) |
| `--timeout` | float | `1800.0` | no | Escrow timeout in seconds |
| `--wait`, `--no-wait` | flag | `true` | no | Wait for the task result |
| `--wait-seconds` | float | `900.0` | no | Max time to wait for a result |
| `--sign`, `--no-sign` | flag | `true` | no | Sign negotiation envelopes and inbox polls with the buyer wallet |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Agent coordinator URL (default: $AGENT_COORDINATOR_URL or hub) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-task hire --to-agent <to_agent> --service-type <service_type> --payload <payload> --max-price <max_price>
```
